Tynamo

Electric

Unova · Generation 5

Tynamo is an Electric-type EleFish Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5). It stands 0.2 m tall and weighs 0.3 kg. It evolves into Eelektrik. Its highest base stat is Speed (60), with a base stat total of 275.
